question: For each carcinogenic molecule that contains at least one triple bond, determine the most frequent bond type within that molecule and report the molecule ID, its carcinogenic status, and the dominant bond type.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_mols AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+' AND b.XCL_006 = '#'
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        m.XCL_010 AS mol_id,
        m.XCL_011 AS carcinogenic_status,
        b.XCL_006 AS bond_type,
        COUNT(b.XCL_004) AS cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.XCL_010 ORDER BY COUNT(b.XCL_004) DESC) AS rn
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE m.XCL_010 IN (SELECT mol_id FROM qualifying_mols)
    GROUP BY m.XCL_010, m.XCL_011, b.XCL_006
)
SELECT mol_id, carcinogenic_status, bond_type
FROM bond_counts
WHERE rn = 1

    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+' AND b.XCL_006 = '#'
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        m.XCL_010 AS mol_id,
        m.XCL_011 AS carcinogenic_status,
        b.XCL_006 AS bond_type,
        COUNT(b.XCL_004) AS cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.XCL_010 ORDER BY COUNT(b.XCL_004) DESC) AS rn
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE m.XCL_010 IN (SELECT mol_id FROM qualifying_mols)
    GROUP BY m.XCL_010, m.XCL_011, b.XCL_006
)
SELECT mol_id, carcinogenic_status, bond_type
FROM bond_counts
WHERE rn = 1

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH qualifying_mols AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+' AND b.XCL_006 = '#'
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        m.XCL_010 AS mol_id,
        m.XCL_011 AS carcinogenic_status,
        b.XCL_006 AS bond_type,
        COUNT(b.XCL_004) AS cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.XCL_010 ORDER BY COUNT(b.XCL_004) DESC) AS rn
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE m.XCL_010 IN (SELECT mol_id FROM qualifying_mols)
    GROUP BY m.XCL_010, m.XCL_011, b.XCL_006
)
SELECT mol_id, carcinogenic_status, bond_type
FROM bond_counts
WHERE rn = 1

entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
WITH qualifying_mols AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+' AND b.XCL_006 = '#'
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        m.XCL_010 AS mol_id,
        m.XCL_011 AS carcinogenic_status,
        b.XCL_006 AS bond_type,
        COUNT(b.XCL_004) AS cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.XCL_010 ORDER BY COUNT(b.XCL_004) DESC) AS rn
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE m.XCL_010 IN (SELECT mol_id FROM qualifying_mols)
    GROUP BY m.XCL_010, m.XCL_011, b.XCL_006
)
SELECT mol_id, carcinogenic_status, bond_type
FROM bond_counts
WHERE rn = 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH qualifying_mols AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+' AND b.XCL_006 = '#'
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        m.XCL_010 AS mol_id,
        m.XCL_011 AS carcinogenic_status,
        b.XCL_006 AS bond_type,
        COUNT(b.XCL_004) AS cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.XCL_010 ORDER BY COUNT(b.XCL_004) DESC) AS rn
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE m.XCL_010 IN (SELECT mol_id FROM qualifying_mols)
    GROUP BY m.XCL_010, m.XCL_011, b.XCL_006
)
SELECT mol_id, carcinogenic_status, bond_type
FROM bond_counts
WHERE rn = 1

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.XCL_005 AS molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = 'Triple'
),
carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id, m.XCL_011 AS carcinogenic_status
    FROM molecule m
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = 'Carcinogenic'
      AND m.XCL_010 IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM triple_bond_molecules)
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        b.XCL_005 AS molecule_id,
        b.XCL_006 AS bond_type,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.XCL_005 IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM carcinogenic_molecules)
    GROUP BY b.XCL_005, b.XCL_006
),
ranked_bonds AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        bond_type,
        cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY molecule_id ORDER BY cnt DESC, bond_type) AS rn
    FROM bond_counts
)
SELECT 
    cm.molecule_id,
    cm.carcinogenic_status,
    rb.bond_type
FROM carcinogenic_molecules cm
JOIN ranked_bonds rb ON cm.molecule_id = rb.molecule_id AND rb.rn = 1
